context.problem: Clients dispute charges after the ship sails and there is no record of what was packed.

goals.metric: disputes per month down 50% in 6 months

successMetrics: disputes per month down 50% within 6 months of go-live

actors.name: Packer
actors.goal: pack an order without paper lists

actors.name: Office staff
actors.goal: invoice the moment goods are delivered
painPoints: waits weeks for the paper delivery order

workflows.name: Order to invoice today
workflows.trigger: ship sends an order by email or phone
steps: office staff key the order in
warehouse packs from a paper list
paper delivery order signed at the dock
invoice raised when the paper returns
exceptions: client disputes a charge after sailing

workflows.name: Order to cash
workflows.label: recommended
workflows.trigger: order received by email or phone

workflows.name: Custom order
workflows.label: confirmed
workflows.trigger: order holds an item that is sourced, not stocked

systems.name: Warehouse operations
systems.purpose: Moves an order from intake to the dock; the one screen a warehouse worker needs.
systems.label: confirmed

systems.name: Orders & invoicing
systems.purpose: Quotation through to a paid invoice.
systems.label: confirmed

features.name: Order pipeline & stage engine
features.does: Moves an order through each stage, with task views per role
features.label: confirmed

features.name: Short-pack alert
features.does: Flags an item that cannot be packed, in time to buy or cancel
features.label: confirmed

features.name: Order intake & quotation
features.does: Captures email and phone orders and prices them
features.label: confirmed

features.name: Invoice from packed quantities
features.does: Raises the invoice from what was packed and shipped
features.label: recommended

features.name: One login, role-based screens
features.does: One login; packers see packing tasks, office staff see orders and invoices
features.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must move each order through the stages Order In, Pack, Pack Review and Shipped.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must let a packer flag an item that cannot be packed and alert office staff.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: Office staff must be able to enter an order received by email or phone and produce a quotation.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must raise the invoice from packed-and-audited quantities.
requirements.label: assumed

requirements.text: The system must provide one login, with packers limited to packing tasks.
requirements.label: confirmed

requirements.text: The system must print a pallet label at the Pack stage.
requirements.label: assumed

scenarios.given: an order of 10 items with 8 packed

nfrs.text: Scans made without connectivity must be kept and synced within 5 minutes of reconnecting.
nfrs.label: assumed

constraints.text: Vessels are offline at sea; delivery orders are signed on paper at the dock today.

assumptions.text: Packers carry a phone with a camera on the warehouse floor.

openQuestions.question: Is order to cash the right shape: quote before the order is confirmed?
openQuestions.reason: the workflow was drafted, not described by the client

openQuestions.question: Should the invoice be raised at shipping, or when the delivery order is signed?
